# ConversionLiftLab

> ConversionLiftLab is Rahim Badsha's CRO (conversion rate optimization) practice: high-converting landing pages, sales funnels, and AI-powered lead/CRM automation for businesses running paid or organic traffic.

Rahim Badsha is a Top Rated Upwork freelancer with a 100% Job Success Score, 10+ years of experience, 1050+ pages and funnels delivered, 358+ reviews, and $200K+ earned on Upwork. Notable long-term clients include TortExpert (2-year retainer) and TrueGoldRepublic (ongoing).

## What ConversionLiftLab does

- Landing page design (hero, social proof, CTA — built from scratch, mobile-first)
- Sales funnel building (optin → upsell → thank-you, with A/B tested flows and email/CRM integration)
- CRO optimization (heatmap analysis, copy rewrites, A/B testing)
- Lead generation pages (squeeze pages, webinar registrations, quiz funnels)
- Platform migration (pixel-perfect rebuilds on a new platform)
- Advertorial & VSL (video sales letter) pages
- AI-powered lead qualification and CRM automation

## Platforms worked on

Webflow, ClickFunnels (1 & 2), GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Unbounce, Instapage, WordPress (Elementor/Divi), Shopify, Systeme.io, Funnelish, Gem Pages, Wix, Squarespace, Kajabi, Kartra, LeadPages, ActiveCampaign, Simvoly, and custom code.

## Pricing

- Starter: $997 one-time — 1 landing page, 3–5 day delivery
- Growth Funnel: $2,997 per project — up to 5 pages, 7–14 day delivery
- Agency Retainer: $4,997/month — ongoing CRO partnership, 4 new pages/month
